user.title: Elpris Forecast
user.description: Track the all-in hourly electricity price (spot + grid tariff + charges, incl. VAT) for a place in Denmark, with a 7-day forecast and learned uncertainty bands.

data_description.place: Four-digit postcode, dk1/dk2, or 'a' + grid area code (as accepted by elpriser.dk).

init.title: Error model
init.description: Changing these re-fits the uncertainty model from the full stored history.

data.min_effective_n: Minimum effective sample size per horizon

data_description.forgetting_factor: Weight decay per newer residual in the same horizon. 0.95 = half-life of ~13.5 residuals (about a week).
data_description.min_scored_days: Distinct target days needed before a horizon gets its own band (until then the publisher's band is shown).
data_description.smoothing_hours: Neighbouring horizons pooled with a triangular kernel.
